# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the latest release receives security updates.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report vulnerabilities privately through [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/nitodeco/glancebar/security/advisories/new). Do not open a public issue.

Include a description, reproduction steps, the affected version, and the potential impact. You can expect an initial response within seven days. Confirmed vulnerabilities will be addressed in a coordinated release; declined reports will receive an explanation.
